senses.gloss: hiṣati (= hīṣati, q.v.), neighs: ˚ti LV 〔236.7〕 (vs); m.c. for hī˚ or Skt. he˚ ? But hi˚ occurs as v.l. for hī˚ Mv 〔ii.160.7〕 (prose).

hīṣati, hīṣyati (also hiṣati, q.v.; comm. on Hem. 〔4.258〕 hīsamaṇaṃ heṣitaṃ, and on Deśīn. 〔8.68〕 hīsamaṇaṃ heṣāravaḥ; cf. Skt. heṣati, hreṣ-), neighs: hīṣyanti (v.l. hreṣyanti) Mv 〔i.308.6〕; hīṣitaṃ 〔ii.160.7〕, it was neighed (v.l. hiṣ˚); hīṣitvā 〔iii.76.2, 12〕. All prose.

hīṣaṇa (nt.; to next plus -ana), neighing of a horse (both mss. in the first two instances, one in the third, bhīṣaṇa; em. Senart): uccena svareṇa hīṣitaṃ, mama ˚ṇa-śabdena … Mv 〔ii.160.7〕; uccena svareṇa ˚ṇa-śabdaṃ kṛtaṃ 〔189.8〕; aśvarājasya ˚ṇa-śabdaṃ śrutvā 〔iii.76.13〕. All prose.
